description: This file defines a public enum `BonjourServiceResolverSupport` with utility functions for resolving network services using Bonjour, including starting a resolution and normalizing host strings.

classes.name: BonjourServiceResolverSupport
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods to assist with Bonjour service resolution, including starting the resolution process and normalizing host addresses.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Schedules the given NetService object in the main run loop and begins resolving it with a specified timeout.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newline characters from a raw host string and removes a trailing '.' if present.
